Home / Services / Sensor and module integration

Making the parts work together

Sensors, displays and wireless modules working together as one device.

A device is built from many parts — sensors, screens, wireless modules. We make sure they all work together smoothly, either by building the solution for you or by using a proven ready-made one, whichever saves you more time and money.

Send an inquiry

Most devices combine parts from different manufacturers. Each one needs software (a driver) to talk to the rest of the system, and getting them to cooperate reliably — timing, power use, interference — is often where projects stall.

We either write the drivers and integration code for your hardware, or select a proven ready-made solution and integrate it. Either way, everything is tested on your actual device and documented, so your team can maintain it.

Built for you

Made to fit your hardware exactly, and the code is fully yours.

Ready-made and proven

We pick, buy and integrate an existing solution — faster and cheaper.

What you get

  • Sensors, displays, wireless modules and more
  • Drivers written for your hardware
  • Selection of ready-made parts and software
  • Tested on your actual device
  • Clear documentation included

When it helps

  • A new sensor or module needs to be added to an existing product.
  • The parts work on their own but not together.
  • A component is being replaced and the software has to follow.

How it works

From the first call to the result.

  1. Review

    We look at your hardware, the parts involved and what they must do.

  2. Recommendation

    Custom or ready-made: we recommend the option that costs less overall, and explain why.

  3. Integration

    Drivers and integration code, tested on your device.

  4. Handover

    Code and documentation handed over to you or your team.

FAQ

Common questions

Can you work on hardware designed by someone else?

Yes. We start by reviewing the existing design and documentation, then integrate the new parts into it.

Custom or ready-made — how do you decide?

By total cost and time: a ready-made solution is usually faster, a custom one fits better and has no licence restrictions. You get a recommendation with reasons and make the decision.

Who owns the code?

You do. Code written for you is handed over in full, with documentation.

Tell us about your project.

Describe the problem or product and where you are now — a rough description is fine. We reply within two working days, and the first call is free.
